preconditions.description: The length of the input string str is between 1 and 30.
The number of allowed swaps K is between 1 and 10.
All characters in the input string str are digits.

postconditions.description: The returned value is a string of digits.
The length of the returned string is the same as the length of the input string.
The numeric value of the returned string is greater than or equal to the numeric value of the input string.

postconditions.expression: sum(1 for i in range(len(str)) if str[i] != return_value[i]) <= K * 2
postconditions.description: The number of differing positions between the input string and the returned string is at most twice the number of allowed swaps K.
